# Wiingy

> > Wiingy is a vetted tutor marketplace connecting learners with specialized instructors across music, voice, and mathematics subjects.

Wiingy offers a curated platform for finding top-rated tutors in vocal training, singing instruction, music theory, and mathematics. The marketplace features experienced educators who provide personalized, one-on-one online lessons tailored to individual learning goals and skill levels.
